preconditions.description: The number of nodes `n` is an odd integer between 3 and 10^5 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= parent < n or parent == -1 for parent, _ in nodes) and len(nodes) == n
preconditions.description: The tree has `n` nodes, each with a parent (root has parent -1) and a key. All node keys are distinct positive integers ≤ 10^9.
The number of search keys `k` is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(key not in node_keys for key in search_keys) and len(search_keys) == k
preconditions.description: All search keys are distinct positive integers ≤ 10^9 and differ from all node keys.

preconditions.expression: all(keys[left] < keys[parent] < keys[right] for parent, (left, right) in children.items() if left != -1 and right != -1)
preconditions.description: The tree is a valid BST: for every inner node, its key is strictly greater than all keys in its left subtree and strictly smaller than all keys in its right subtree.

postconditions.expression: len(output) == k and all(isinstance(x, float) for x in output)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly `k` real numbers, one for each search key.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(expected - correct_expectation(key, tree)) <= 1e-9 for expected, key in zip(output, search_keys))
postconditions.description: For each search key, the output is the expectation value of the leaf key reached when exactly one mistake is made during the search, with absolute or relative error ≤ 10^-9. The expectation is computed as the average of all possible leaf keys reachable by exactly one mistake in the search path.
